items.title: Investors Rotate Out of Chip Stocks
items.summary: The market has been spooked by concerns of tech giants’ ballooning spending and signs that China may be catching up in the AI arms race.  Asian chip stocks plunged, sending South Korea’s Kospi index 10% lower and Japan’s Nikkei down 4%.  The worst-hit American names included memory makers  Sandisk  which fell another 14%, and Micron, which shed 8.9%.

items.title: CXMT, Sandisk, ASML, SpaceX, D-Wave Quantum, Workday, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  A chip stock slide weighed on the major indexes following reports that a state-backed Chinese company has begun mass producing chip-making machines. Those same semiconductor companies, and many artificial-intelligence names, also were under pressure Monday after Chinese memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies ’(CXMT) massive trading debut.

items.title: Salesforce Surges 7%, ServiceNow Jumps 8%, Workday Jumps 10% as Software Rebounds on AI Rotation
items.summary: Enterprise software names are staging one of their sharpest single-day reversals of the year, and the catalyst has less to do with their own fundamentals than with what is happening in a completely different corner of the market.

items.title: Software Is Beating Chips for Once. It May Not Be a Flash in the Pan.
items.summary: Enterprise software providers, many left behind in the artificial-intelligence boom, were the apparent beneficiaries of a pullback in chip and hardware stocks.  Workday  the human-resources software provider, was the top performer in the large-cap index on Monday, jumping 9.3%.  Altogether, the much-watched  exchange-traded fund, or IGV, rose 4%, while the  ETF, or SOXX, slumped 3.1%.
